scope: Unnötiges Leeren und erneutes Laden unveränderter Ordner nach Auswahl-/Bereichsspeicherung beheben.

steps: Selecting an entry retains all 70 row nodes and sends no folder requests.
A remote resume-only event preserves row and inspector DOM nodes without folder reloads.
Analysis and Manage area switches reuse unchanged complete folder contents.
Remembered closed folders load structure and authoritative counts without requesting their contents.
A 70-entry folder is published atomically after both internal pages; no partial rows appear.
A bulk selection survives a revision refresh with a failed folder and is restored after retry.
A two-entry bulk selection survives loading a sibling folder without losing checked rows.
Selected Details survive a reload inside a closed folder through an item-only lookup.
A folder request failure is local; retry restores its six entries without loading the closed sibling.
Search completes with all 70 matches while an older folder response is still held back.
Origins retains the full provenance result independently of lazy folder contents.
Context collapse remains independent through area switches and a native restart; the free view restores its own state.

note: Der vorangegangene Gesamtlauf bleibt ein historischer Nachweis. Dieser Follow-up prüft die letzten Store-Änderungen gezielt und nativ; keinen weiteren vollständigen pnpm-verify-Lauf behaupten.
